paragraphs.en: 本文综述了面向医学影像的三维扩散模型，比较其性能、局限及未来研究方向。 医学成像的三维扩散模型 Generative deep learning methods such as Variational Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks or Diffusion Models have achieved remarkable results in image synthesis. In particular, Diffusion Models have demonstrated superior image fidelity and sample diversity compared to other approaches on standard benchmarks, while also offering more flexible training dynamics as evidenced both in natural image domains and in medical applications. In medical imaging including Computed Tomography, Magnetic Resonance Imaging or Positron Emission Tomography, such models have various important use-cases including data augmentation, domain transfer, image reconstruction, inpainting, image augmentation and artifact correction. Further, generated images can be conditioned on patient characteristics, medical reports, segmentation masks or other images. Specific challenges arise due to the 3D volumetric nature of medical images, which translate to substantial demands in terms of memory, compute, and training data. This article provides a comparative overview of 3D Diffusion Models which have been developed for medical images, with a focus on current performance, limitations, and an outlook for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 本文综述了面向医学影像的三维扩散模型，比较其性能、局限及未来研究方向。医学成像的三维扩散模型：变分自编码器、生成对抗网络或扩散模型等生成式深度学习方法在图像合成方面取得了显著成果。 特别是，扩散模型在标准基准上相较于其他方法展现出更优的图像保真度和样本多样性，同时还提供了更灵活的训练动态，这在自然图像领域和医学应用中都得到了证实。 在包括计算机断层扫描、磁共振成像或正电子发射断层扫描在内的医学影像中，此类模型具有多种重要用途，包括数据增强、域迁移、图像重建、修复、图像增强和伪影校正。 此外，生成的图像可以基于患者特征、医学报告、分割掩模或其他图像进行条件化。 由于医学图像的三维体数据特性，会带来一些特定的挑战，这些挑战转化为对内存、算力和训练数据的大量需求。 本文对为医学图像开发的三维扩散模型进行了比较性概述，重点关注当前的性能、局限性以及对未来工作的展望。
